source: an inline JSON llmBackendsConfig (secret fields masked at any depth, other fields intact, an apostrophe in a value) and a header-list prometheusRemoteWriteHeaders reach GET /mockserver/config and /mockserver/configuration redacted, from the system-property tier (quoting that survives JSON), the environment tier and the properties-file tier. The same document through each tier answers the same value with its own source.

steps.note: the effective configuration: the inline JSON document is redacted field by field (system-property tier); the header list likewise (file tier wins over the environment)
the sibling /mockserver/configuration redacts the same values
